title: First-run principal sees the tour open on the highest-value surface and can walk it or dismiss it with the keyboard
iWant: the tour to open on the highest-value surface with the first step, and to be able to walk through it or dismiss it using only the keyboard
soThat: I can learn the surface my project ships without a mouse, and I can leave the tour at any point without a trap

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a first-run principal on the SPA, the tour opens on the highest-value surface with the first step; Escape dismisses the tour and hides the tooltip; keyboard-only users reach every tour control (previous, next, dismiss) via Tab in DOM order and activate the next control with Enter (WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order). Anchors to TAC-2701-application-onboarding-tour-step-runner; probed by application-onboarding-tour.pack.mjs check AC-26101-1.

When the current step's anchor selector resolves to nothing at open, the runner refuses the step render, focus stays on the last known anchor (or on the tour launcher for the first step), and the console log carries data-error=TOUR_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED naming the selector; no floating dialog surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the current step has an anchor that resolves to no element
acceptanceCriteria.when: the runner attempts to open the step
acceptanceCriteria.then: the step is skipped or the tour is closed with a defined error, no floating dialog appears, and data-error=TOUR_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED is logged

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the current step's anchor resolves to an invisible or clipped element that cannot fit the tooltip at the current breakpoint, the runner refuses the render and emits data-error=TOUR_ANCHOR_UNFIT; the dialog never renders floating or off-screen.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the current step's anchor is present but hidden or clipped for the current viewport
acceptanceCriteria.when: the runner attempts to open the step
acceptanceCriteria.then: no tooltip renders, data-error=TOUR_ANCHOR_UNFIT is logged with the anchor and breakpoint, and the tour offers the next step or a defined close

acceptanceCriteria.description: The tour opens on the highest-value surface as named by the elicited step manifest (the first step's anchor selector determines the surface); a manifest with fewer than 3 steps or more than 5 refuses at apply with STEP_MANIFEST_OUT_OF_RANGE naming the count.
acceptanceCriteria.when: apply runs against a step manifest with an out-of-range count
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply exits with a non-zero code and STEP_MANIFEST_OUT_OF_RANGE names the count and the required range

acceptanceCriteria.description: The elicited `tour-step-manifest` value is the ordered step list the runner walks; each entry names a step id, an anchor selector, a heading and a body. A manifest with fewer than 3 or more than 5 entries refuses at apply with STEP_MANIFEST_OUT_OF_RANGE naming the count. Applying agent sets: tour-step-manifest.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project applying application-onboarding-tour with a tour-step-manifest of N entries
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply exits 0 with 3<=N<=5 and refuses with STEP_MANIFEST_OUT_OF_RANGE otherwise, naming N and the required range

acceptanceCriteria.description: The elicited `anchor-selectors` value supplies the per-step CSS selector the runner passes to document.querySelector at step-open time; a step whose selector resolves to no element or to a clipped element refuses the render with data-error=TOUR_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED or TOUR_ANCHOR_UNFIT respectively (see AC-26101-2 and AC-26101-3). Applying agent sets: anchor-selectors.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project applying application-onboarding-tour with anchor-selectors set per manifest step
acceptanceCriteria.then: the runner queries the DOM with the elicited selector for that step and refuses the render with the named data-error when the selector does not resolve to a visible unclipped element

acceptanceCriteria.description: The elicited `per-step-content-voice` value supplies the heading and body strings the tooltip surfaces verbatim for each step; a step whose heading or body resolves to an empty string refuses at apply with STEP_CONTENT_MISSING naming the step id. Applying agent sets: per-step-content-voice.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project applying application-onboarding-tour with per-step-content-voice set for each manifest step
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply refuses with STEP_CONTENT_MISSING naming the offending step id when any heading or body is empty, and exits 0 with the strings surfaced verbatim in the tooltip DOM at runtime otherwise
